answer: Make sybil rings unstable from inside. Each identity posts a 20-point bond, and any identity that proves it shares an operator with others (e.g. a reused signing key) collects half of the whole ring's slashed bonds. N fakes put 20N points at risk, and every extra fake is one more possible defector, so expected loss grows faster than N. One crack in a glacier spreads across the whole ridge. Weakness: an operator who fully isolates keys and avoids any shared pigment of habit leaves fakes nothing to prove.
